tables.name: agent_farmers
tables.explicitCreateSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_farmers ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, agent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, farmer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, assigned_by BIGINT REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT unique_agent_farmer_assignment UNIQUE (agent_id, farmer_id) )
